title: Interesting Idea But Odd Implementation - Not The Best Value for Me
text:
Overall, the box was decent but not exceed my expectations. I like the idea that if you see a box on their website that you like, you can go ahead and get it at a great discount compared to full retail price for the items when purchased individually. I see no advantage to buying this on Amazon rather than the GQ site. It might be easier to cancel through Amazon? If I had purchased through GQ site directly, I would actually have received a free bonus item, a pair of socks.

I ordered a box in May 2019 which was delivered on June 1. I expected that the first box delivered would be the summer edition that had not yet been released. I was a bit disappointed when the box arrived with with the spring items that had already been revealed on GQ site, Instagram, and other subscription blogs. This completely eliminated the surprise factor of the subscription box for new items. My initial reaction was negative since I had already seen the items inside online! If I had known that this box would be the spring box, I would not have purchased it. If you like the items pictured on the GQ site, go ahead and order! If not, hold off for the next quarter.

Part of what lead to my expectation that I would receive the summer box was that it wasn't going to be delivered immediately like normal prime items. Seeing the expected delivery of June made it seem like these would be summer items. It appears that these ship out in batches each month with the same boxes for a three month window.

Specific to the Spring box (MSA blog valued this box at ~$177):

I liked getting to try new toiletry items such as shaving cream and moisturizer, however I felt that this box was too focused on this type of item. The website and product description (estimated box value) made it seem like the box would include full size items. However, the box shipped with mostly trial size items - the bar of soap was full size. Great if you are interested in trying new toiletries but don't expect full size packages.

I have used the mophie battery pack a few times. Always nice to have another spare charger. I would not have specifically purchased this brand or paid full price for it.

The Hims gummy bear supplement was an interesting idea - However this had a significant amount of sugar and was basically gummy bears + emergen-C/Airborne. I expected that this would be a gummy vitamin. I opened the bottle and these smelled awful - I gave these away at work.

The bluetooth speaker was not what I expected. The color in all the GQ website images was black, however the one I received was blue. Additionally, the blue color did not match the color on the packaging and was very shiny which made it look cheap. I already have a bluetooth speaker. I didn't need an additional one so I gave this away as well.
label: neutral
